submit_competition_file: submit a local file to a HuggingFace competition using competition_id and token
submit_competition_hub_repo: submit a HuggingFace hub repo to a competition with an optional comment
register_submit_subcommand: register the submit subcommand parser with competition_id submission comment and token arguments
run_submit_command: run the SubmitCompetitionAppCommand to POST a submission to the competition API endpoint
submit_commands_factory: create a SubmitCompetitionAppCommand instance from argparse args for competition submission
